Windows x64 preview of Loop.

- Create, run, and package Rust component applications.
- Install from https://isaac10334.github.io/loop/.
- Upgrade with `loop upgrade`; remove with `loop uninstall` or Windows Settings.
- Generated native hosts use the published `loop-host` crate.

Building applications requires MSVC Build Tools and the Windows SDK.
Desktop windows require WebView2. APIs may change. TypeScript remains experimental.

The ZIP contains a portable CLI. Use the PowerShell installer for managed
upgrade and uninstall. The adjacent SHA-256 file verifies the ZIP.
